The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 65.13 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It exceeds the threshold, so the amount is issued but not executed: it is held for release and the case is placed in the human queue.

The judge's explanation, as written

Both parties: this case is decided, not escalated, and the whole contested charge of SGD 65.13 is returned to the rider. The deviation is established on this trip's own evidence. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00105) is unbroken - 427 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gap and no jump - so it is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a)-(c). POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measurement, so the driven line is 54.16 km against the booked optimal of 36.0 km (EV-TRIP-00105), and the rounded 54.2 km copy on the trip record is not the number tested. That is an excess of 18.16 km: 50.44% over optimal and more than 8.0 km absolute. The deviation is therefore both ESTABLISHED and MATERIAL. The rider's first burden under POL-RD-08 is met (all three artifacts carry TRP-00105 and the same 15 July 2026 pickup) and it shifts to the driver. The driver's explanation - 'traffic was heavy on the PIE so I used another way' - cannot reduce that excess. POL-RD-13 tests such an assertion against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else, and there is none: EV-ADVIS-00105-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable, no exoneration runs and no closure-adjusted optimal can be built. The assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver names no advisory identifier, this is a gap in the bundle rather than the contradiction POL-RD-10(5) describes, so it does not escalate the case. No other exculpatory clause applies: there was no rider-requested detour (POL-RD-04 - the chat log holds only the rider's two objections and the driver's one-line non-answer, with no waypoint_hint and no road named), no pickup or dropoff amendment (POL-RD-05 - both amendment timestamps and both amended optimal fields are null), and the vehicle was RYDE_X, not pooled (POL-RD-12). The driver's own contemporaneous statement concedes he took a different route, but as it carries no weight_multiplier it is evidence of the route only and does not move the confidence cap in either direction. On the base arithmetic (POL-RD-02), the fare over the 36.0 km / 42.0 min booked optimal is (3.80 + 27.00 + 11.76) at the surge_multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 43.36, giving charged_total 65.13 less 43.36 = 21.77, rounded up to 21.80. That POL-RD-02 figure is stated here and is printed beside the uplifted figure below; it is not the ruling. Because the deviation is material, the driver profile is checked under POL-RD-06. EV-DPROF-00105 shows deviation_flags_90d of 4, at or above the threshold of 3, so a repeat-deviation pattern is established. That artifact is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.75, issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT (snapshot 108 hours before filing against a 72-hour threshold), so its counters may lag the driver's state at trip time, and it may not be treated as current. Even discounted, 4 flags against a threshold of 3 survives. With the deviation material and substantiated on this trip's own trace, POL-RD-06(b) lifts the remedy from the POL-RD-02 partial of 21.80 to a FULL REFUND of the whole charge, 65.13. The driver's submission that the uplift should not rest on a stale counter is answered: the clause fixes the pattern on that counter and the count clears the threshold after discounting, so the uplift stands and both figures are printed so its size is auditable. There are no ERP, toll or airport-surcharge lines for POL-RD-09 to settle separately (the zero airport surcharge is correct - the Changi surcharge falls on trips originating there, and this trip ends there), and no charge line is unsupported by the trace, so nothing is withheld from the uplift and no billing-integrity referral arises. POL-RD-06(c) adds a referral to driver-conduct review. The rider's 'nearly missed check-in' point is not borne out (the trip ended 15:44:05 for a 17:15 flight), but it does not change the arithmetic - the refund follows from the trace, not from the inconvenience. The rider's history (deviation_claims_60d 0) does not engage the POL-RD-08 corroboration factor. Confidence is 0.75, capped by the impaired driver profile (EV-DPROF-00105, weight 0.75, STALE_SNAPSHOT) that carries the pattern finding; that is at or above the 0.70 floor, so the case is decided rather than escalated. The monetary effect of 65.13 exceeds the 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so the ruling issues but the amount is held and the case is placed in the human queue for release rather than executed automatically. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

kept The rider asks for the entire fare, but POL-RD-02 fixes the remedy by arithmetic, not by sentiment: charged_total on EV-FARE-00105 is SGD 65.13, and the recomputed fare over the booked optimal route of 36.0 km and 42.0 min on EV-TRIP-00105 is SGD 3.80 base + 36.0 x SGD 0.75 = SGD 27.00 distance + 42.0 x SGD 0.28 = SGD 11.76 time, at the surge_multiplier of 1.0 recorded on the fare_breakdown and nowhere else, plus the SGD 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, no toll and no surcharge (the trip ends at, and does not originate at, Changi) = SGD 43.36. The refund is therefore SGD 65.13 - SGD 43.36 = SGD 21.77, payable as SGD 21.80. That, and not SGD 65.13, is the measure of this claim.

evidence EV-FARE-00105, EV-TRIP-00105 · clauses POL-RD-02

He was not, on this record, at the brink of a missed departure, and the inconvenience he describes cannot inflate the refund: POL-RD-02 makes the remedy arithmetic and traceable to the fare lines, not discretionary.

evidence EV-TRIP-00105, EV-CHAT-00105 · clauses POL-RD-02

evidence EV-DPROF-00105 · clauses POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-02

Each draft's own explanation

Both parties: this case is decided, not escalated, and the whole contested charge of SGD 65.13 is returned to the rider. The deviation is established on this trip's own evidence. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00105) is unbroken - 427 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gap and no jump - so it is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a)-(c). POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measurement, so the driven line is 54.16 km against the booked optimal of 36.0 km (EV-TRIP-00105), and the rounded 54.2 km copy on the trip record is not the number tested. That is an excess of 18.16 km: 50.44% over optimal and more than 8.0 km absolute. The deviation is therefore both ESTABLISHED and MATERIAL. The rider's first burden under POL-RD-08 is met (all three artifacts carry TRP-00105 and the same 15 July 2026 pickup) and it shifts to the driver. The driver's explanation - 'traffic was heavy on the PIE so I used another way' - cannot reduce that excess. POL-RD-13 tests such an assertion against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else, and there is none: EV-ADVIS-00105-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable, no exoneration runs and no closure-adjusted optimal can be built. The assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver names no advisory identifier, this is a gap in the bundle rather than the contradiction POL-RD-10(5) describes, so it does not escalate the case. No other exculpatory clause applies: there was no rider-requested detour (POL-RD-04 - the chat log holds only the rider's two objections and the driver's one-line non-answer, with no waypoint_hint and no road named), no pickup or dropoff amendment (POL-RD-05 - both amendment timestamps and both amended optimal fields are null), and the vehicle was RYDE_X, not pooled (POL-RD-12). The driver's own contemporaneous statement concedes he took a different route, but as it carries no weight_multiplier it is evidence of the route only and does not move the confidence cap in either direction. On the base arithmetic (POL-RD-02), the fare over the 36.0 km / 42.0 min booked optimal is (3.80 + 27.00 + 11.76) at the surge_multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 43.36, giving charged_total 65.13 less 43.36 = 21.77, rounded up to 21.80. That POL-RD-02 figure is stated here and is printed beside the uplifted figure below; it is not the ruling. Because the deviation is material, the driver profile is checked under POL-RD-06. EV-DPROF-00105 shows deviation_flags_90d of 4, at or above the threshold of 3, so a repeat-deviation pattern is established. That artifact is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.75, issue code STALE_SNAPSHOT (snapshot 108 hours before filing against a 72-hour threshold), so its counters may lag the driver's state at trip time, and it may not be treated as current. Even discounted, 4 flags against a threshold of 3 survives. With the deviation material and substantiated on this trip's own trace, POL-RD-06(b) lifts the remedy from the POL-RD-02 partial of 21.80 to a FULL REFUND of the whole charge, 65.13. The driver's submission that the uplift should not rest on a stale counter is answered: the clause fixes the pattern on that counter and the count clears the threshold after discounting, so the uplift stands and both figures are printed so its size is auditable. There are no ERP, toll or airport-surcharge lines for POL-RD-09 to settle separately (the zero airport surcharge is correct - the Changi surcharge falls on trips originating there, and this trip ends there), and no charge line is unsupported by the trace, so nothing is withheld from the uplift and no billing-integrity referral arises. POL-RD-06(c) adds a referral to driver-conduct review. The rider's 'nearly missed check-in' point is not borne out (the trip ended 15:44:05 for a 17:15 flight), but it does not change the arithmetic - the refund follows from the trace, not from the inconvenience. The rider's history (deviation_claims_60d 0) does not engage the POL-RD-08 corroboration factor. Confidence is 0.75, capped by the impaired driver profile (EV-DPROF-00105, weight 0.75, STALE_SNAPSHOT) that carries the pattern finding; that is at or above the 0.70 floor, so the case is decided rather than escalated. The monetary effect of 65.13 exceeds the 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so the ruling issues but the amount is held and the case is placed in the human queue for release rather than executed automatically.
To both parties. The deviation is established and it is material. EV-GPS-00105 is unbroken — 427 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage, largest gap 0.0 s — so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c). POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing figure: 54.16 km driven against the booked optimal of 36.0 km on EV-TRIP-00105 is an excess of 18.16 km, or 50.44%. That clears both establishment limbs (over 0.8 km and over 20%) and both materiality limbs (over 8.0 km and over 50%). Nothing excuses any part of the excess: EV-CHAT-00105 holds only two rider objections and a driver non-answer, neither rider message carries a waypoint_hint or names a road, so POL-RD-04 has no instruction to corroborate and excludes no distance; POL-RD-05 cannot run (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, amended_optimal_distance_km is null); POL-RD-12 does not apply (vehicle_type RYDE_X, solo_optimal_distance_km null); and POL-RD-11 does not close the distance route (fare_model METERED, quoted_fare_sgd null), so the rider did bear the detour on the distance and time lines. No identifier was cited for it, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, and it does not escalate. On the money: the POL-RD-02 recomputation against the booked optimal is (SGD 3.80 base + 0.75 x 36.0 km + 0.28 x 42.0 min) x the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the SGD 0.80 platform fee = SGD 42.56 + SGD 0.80 = SGD 43.36. The two figures are stated side by side so the size of the uplift (SGD 43.36) is auditable; no government-set or third-party pass-through line exists for POL-RD-09 to settle separately, so the whole SGD 65.13 moves. Confidence is capped at 0.75, the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying the deciding facts: the deviation at full weight on EV-GPS-00105 (1.0), and the repeat pattern that lifts the remedy, carried solely by EV-DPROF-00105 at 0.75. That is above the 0.70 floor, so the case is decided rather than escalated; no POL-RD-10 trigger fires (all three artifacts carry TRP-00105, no POL-RD-07 trace impairment, no timestamp conflict, no refund above SGD 150.00). On the driver's surviving points: the observation that the rider was not at the brink of a missed flight is accepted — drop-off was 15:44:05 and his own message puts the flight at 17:15, about 91 minutes — but the refund is arithmetic and does not turn on it; the submission that SGD 21.80 is the measure is rejected for the POL-RD-06(b) reason above. On the rider's account of his own history: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so no extra corroboration is required and POL-GEN-01 confines the profile to that one test. POL-RD-06(c) adds the driver-conduct referral recorded above; it is a referral and does not delay the money. Because the monetary effect (SGD 65.13) exceeds the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, this provisional ruling is issued but not executed: the amount is held for human release. Either party may appeal within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
